excerpt.zh: 科研团队在调查[From.GetName]的时候发现了一处来自行星的冰层之下的异常热信号。
excerpt.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

texts.zh: 科研团队在调查[From.GetName]的时候发现了一处来自行星的冰层之下的异常热信号。
texts.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

sections.zh: 科研团队在调查[From.GetName]的时候发现了一处来自行星的冰层之下的异常热信号。
sections.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

texts.zh: 在探察冰面下方之后我们得出结论，这处位于[From.GetName]的异常热信号是由热液泉引起的。类似的地方这个星球上似乎还有更多，但是我们尚未发现。
texts.en: After probing beneath the surface, we have concluded the unusual heat signatures on [From.GetName] are caused by hydrothermal springs. There seems to be more to this planet than meets the eye...

label.zh: 真是棒极了。但我们没必要继续在这上面耗费精力了。
label.en: Remarkable. But we need not waste any more resources on this.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的船员的进一步探索揭示出热水来源的行星地壳深处竟然密布着微观生命体！我们一度以为空无一物的冰封星球事实上孕育着一个欣欣向荣的水下生物圈。
texts.en: Continued exploration by the crew of [From.GetName] has revealed the hot water coming from deep within the planet's crust is teeming with microscopic life! What we once thought of as an empty, frozen planet, actually contains a thriving underwater biosphere!
